name: Goetze's Caramel Creams (Bullseyes Chewy Caramels)
whyItWorks: Unlike sticky tooth-pulling caramels, Goetze's Caramel Creams are made with wheat flour, giving them a soft, cake-like chew with a creamy vanilla center. Low residue and gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew slowly. A wonderful old-school comfort candy that avoids chocolate and nuts.
